title: Keep the eight-setting contact measurement and its error budget as actual prerequisites
statement: The reviewed one-mode-at-a-time central-difference protocol uses eight vector settings. Entry error includes2*s_i/h_j plus each preload’s truncation,nuisance and calibration. Full switching needs the stated load/gap/residual envelope;combined simultaneous probes change the max to a sum. The19fm individual displacement tolerance is calculated,not achieved.

assumptions: A finite aperture also needs an opening/service model-error enclosure

body: Do not mix nominal zero-residual service with residual-bearing acquisition as one protocol. A failing sufficient upper does not establish physical component failure. Actual contact stiffness,full switching,strict burial,lateral boundary correction,metrology and no-growth/reversibility are unacquired. No interaction/finite-component qualification or stronger-than-ordinary advantage follows. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
